problems.quote: The decline of the Zamindari system due to British land revenue policies

problems.correction: The establishment of the Zamindari system by British land revenue policies
problems.verifierReason: Original claim misattributes decline to British policies; correction accurately states British policies created Zamindari.

problems.quote: According to the 2011 Census, the Yadav literacy rate rose from 45 % to 68 % between 1991 and 2011

problems.correction: Empirical studies indicate Yadav literacy rose significantly between 1991 and 2011
problems.verifierReason: Census does not publish caste‑wise literacy; specific figures are unfounded. Correction appropriately generalizes.
